persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.message: Uh, I think it’s Jamal Whitfield — that’s the name I go by, anyway, on my documents.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Uh… I’m not really sure how to answer that one. I’ve been seeing a doctor, but psychiatrist or, I don’t know, specialist maybe? I’m mixing them up a bit. What do you mean exactly?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please answer yes or no.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s been… a bit hard to explain, honestly. For maybe eight months now I’ve had this growing feeling that the neighbours are watching me and talking about me, and sometimes I hear my name being called when nobody’s there. I keep thinking, maybe it’s real, maybe it isn’t — I’m not fully sure. I ended up withdrawing from my college course too, which has been a mess, and I just want to figure out what’s happening and get back to it.
